brief: The number of distinct native module and method pairs called during the lifetime of the span. Only applies to React Native.

deprecation.reason: Replaced by the `react_native.module.*` namespace, which also covers native module calls made over the Old Architecture bridge, and which drops the `total_` prefix and `_ms` suffix in favor of dot-separated logical grouping

changelog.description: Added turbo_module.unique_methods and deprecated it in favor of react_native.module.call.distinct_count
